entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Identity: external login ProviderKey equality is delegated to the database collation #68258
  • ASP.NET Core graceful shutdown never runs on Azure App Service Linux (blessed .NET 8 stack): no SIGTERM, no `ApplicationStopping`, no `ProcessExit` on portal Stop or Restart #68252
  • Build scripts hard-disable MSBuild node reuse, hurting inner-loop perf and blocking MSBuild Server #68251

Closed

  • description is missing when using with FromForm #59042
    Backlog
  • Add better warnings and errors for Sections #66831
    11.0-rc1
  • Drop Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Client #68203

    11.0-rc1

    11.0-rc1
